title: processkit Binding
description: A typed relation stored as an item (ontology@v1 relations). Every Binding has spec.relation, spec.subject, and spec.target, and may have spec.scope, spec.validity, and spec.description. Endpoints, cardinality, and whether a relation type allows scope are checked against the ontology registry (ontology@v1 PK-MODEL-070); in v1 only grants-role allows scope. For grants-role (access-control@v1 PK-ACC-021, PK-ACC-041) the subject is a principal object, the target a Role, and the scope a Container, required; a Binding scoped to the root Container names Container/root. metadata is ontology@v1 schemas/resource-metadata.schema.json.

relation.description: Relation type name from the registry member relationTypes.

subject.description: A typed reference, or a principal object where the relation type's subject endpoint is principal. Any other form for grants-role is reported as ontology.relation-endpoint.

scope.description: Typed reference to a Container. Containers have no namespace.

principal.description: A user or group principal, named by the identifier the authenticator asserts (PK-ACC-018).

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive identifier: a user identifier or a group name as the authenticator asserts it.

validity.description: Time bounds of the relation. A grant is valid at time t when from <= t < until; an absent bound does not limit. Both bounds are RFC 3339 timestamps with an explicit offset. If from is not before until, the Binding is invalid (access.invalid-validity) and grants nothing.
